description: Na₆MgV₂O₈ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are six inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four NaO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four VO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.35 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four VO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one MgO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.36 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.17-2.63 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.47-2.68 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.18-2.60 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four VO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one MgO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.36 Å. Mg is bonded to four O atoms to form MgO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four VO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.97-2.02 Å. There are two inequivalent V sites. In the first V site, V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent MgO₄ tetrahedra and corners with six NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.77-1.92 Å. In the second V site, V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent MgO₄ tetrahedra and corners with six NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.80-1.90 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to three Na and one V atom to form ONa₃V tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONa₃V tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent ONa₂MgV trigonal pyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded to three Na and one V atom to form ONa₃V tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONa₃MgV square pyramids and corners with two equivalent ONa₃V tetrahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one V atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one V atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Mg, and one V atom to form distorted ONa₂MgV trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₃MgV square pyramids and corners with two equivalent ONa₃V tetrahedra. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Mg, and one V atom to form distorted ONa₃MgV square pyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₃V tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent ONa₂MgV trigonal pyramids. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one V atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one V atom.
